source_execution: The exact JavaScript function was serialized via Function.prototype.toString(), committed as an ES module, read back from GitHub, compared byte-for-byte to the serialized function, then invoked once on independent smoke seeds and once on the preregistered primary cohort in the same V8 isolate. This preserves source identity without claiming an independent runner or dual-platform qualification.
result_contains: Full per-world 36-row summaries, each arm/scenario score and frozen seed labels, but not all individual held transition outcomes. No model/data file beyond source-free synthetic generator.
generator: 5 observable states; 2 actions; Q=.85; hidden FNV1a/xorshift32 streams; independent hidden/source/training/held; per-action state Dirichlet(0.5) readout
comparator_custody: Strongest fitted conventional comparator: hierarchical mixture of no/local/global change with prior .25/.50/.25; exact structural source-family oracle is separately measured and not target for positive expected-Brier superiority.
source_identity_replay: Not performed; consumed primary seeds are explicitly not replayable for additional scientific claims. Source readback is exact and the committed result is independently arithmetically audited from its per-world rows.
runtime: Ephemeral connected-tool V8 isolate; no separate CPU/OS time measurement, no owner runner, no GPU, no paid API, no scheduled task
